description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableAcknowledgementLabel implementing the AcknowledgementLabel interface. It provides factory methods and overrides for equality, hashCode, and string representation, encapsulating a String label with validation and custom equality logic.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementLabel
classes.description: Immutable implementation of AcknowledgementLabel that encapsulates a string label value and provides standard object methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAcknowledgementLabel instance from a given CharSequence, converting it to String.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the encapsulated label string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index of the label.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the label string between start and end indices.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, considering class type and label value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the label string.
